## Conference organization {#conference-organization}

::: {.record-row}
::: {.record-label}
27–29 December 2025
:::
::: {.record-body}
**Convener, PLASMA 2025** — 40th PSSI National Symposium on Plasma Science & Technology, IIT Tirupati. Served among the conveners alongside Prof. Shihabudheen M. Maliyekkal and Dr. S. Sunil Kumar. The symposium brought together the plasma-science community across fundamental research, fusion, space plasmas, and applications. [Conference archive](https://iittpplasma2025.vercel.app/) · [Proceedings & talks archive](https://iittpplasma2025.vercel.app/proceedings).
:::
:::
